# Refine

## Goal

Improve repository instructions from explicit preferences and observed work.

## Procedure

Review the current task evidence and relevant learning files. Identify a repeatable lesson, its supporting observation, and where it applies. Update [Learning.md](../KnowledgeBase/Learning.md), [Learning_Coding.md](../Learning/Learning_Coding.md), or [Learning_Testing.md](../Learning/Learning_Testing.md) without turning one-off guesses into global rules.

Preserve higher-priority instructions, user scope, and phase boundaries. Explain changed guidance and validate links. Do not fabricate a history of implementation or tests.

## Output

A small evidence-backed refinement with its rationale and scope.
